title: a cross-module call in a parameter default carries the callee's requirement row
notes:
specification/requirements.mdx, 'Inference': "Calling a function with unsatisfied requirements MUST add those capabilities to the caller's R row ... Requirement inference MUST be transitive through ordinary calls." A parameter default executes inside its callee, so its calls contribute to that function's row. The called count function here is pure and the unchanged program prints 0. Measured 2026-09-07: native compile and execution succeed with stdout ["0"]; the legacy JS-labelled emitter still reports VIBE1802 at 3:38. Native unit tests additionally verify missing-provider rejection, provided execution, nested binding defaults, callbacks, methods, constructors, and preservation of the default's requirement in source-free published declarations. History: this case formerly required VIBE1802 because neither implementation attributed a default initializer's row; that safety wall was appropriate while the analysis was absent, not a language rule prohibiting defaults. The historical case id is retained.

2026-09-07 retirement: the SDK-hosted path now uses the native lowerer, meeting this marker's declared emitter-migration retirement condition. Both profiles execute the unchanged source and print 0; no source or output expectation changed.
